thread:
maria: Quick sync — I'm drafting a follow-up RFC on canary/A-B rollouts + automatic fallback. Need to decide clear boundaries: what decisions live in rollout-controller vs router vs runtime? I sketched options, want quick take.

jon: +1. My take: rollout-controller owns policy (who gets what, percentages, health thresholds). Router is a thin decision point (route by policy + realtime signals). Runtime owns fast local fallback (per-request KV cache, local spike detection) so we don't wait on controller.

sam: Concern: if controller becomes partitioned we can still drift. We should add a lease and local hedges in router/runtime. e.g.

```
# pseudo
if controller_lease.invalid():
  route_to(fallback_variant)
elif local_error_rate > 0.05:
  percent_defer_to_fallback()
```

priya: Telemetry implications — controller-policy decisions need strong signals: p99 latency, per-model 5m error-rate, rehab windows. Also need a compact contract for signals between runtime/router and controller (versioned proto). Keep cardinality low.

jon: Agree on versioned contract. Tradeoff: centralizing rollback logic gives consistent behavior but increases control-plane latency for rapid spikes. Local heuristics must be conservative and auditable (and emit events).

sam: Suggestion: three-layer fallback: 1) immediate local fast-fail (runtime), 2) router hedging + sampling to controller for confirmation, 3) controller-wide diversion/rollback. Each layer emits events to the same signal bus (topic: rollout.signals).

engbot: deploy-bot: canary-policy v0.4 applied to cluster us-west-2 at 2026-03-21T15:12:00Z 

maria: Good pattern. Action items: (1) priya draft compact signal proto (metric names, window sizes, enums) (2) jon outline router-lite lease + fallback HTTP API and error codes (3) sam prototype local hedging sim and report perf/cost tradeoffs. I'll fold into RFC and ping arch for sign-off next week.

priya: On it. I'll include exact metric names, cardinality limits, and an example proto.

jon: Will sketch API. Prefer simple REST endpoints plus optional streaming for high-frequency telemetry (gRPC stream).

sam: I'll run a small chaos/partition sim against local hedging and post results to the thread.

maria: Thanks all. /cc @priya @jon @sam
